module: Tile generator of the gameplay selector for campaigns (legacy system). It adds one tile per campaign returned by campaign_campaignsLoader.getList() and builds the details panel with a "Start Campaign" button. It is called via the hooks onGameplaySelectorGetTiles and onGameplaySelectorGetDetails.
notes: Campaign tiles are only added for the gameplaySelector backend; the "More Campaigns..." tile is added for all backends (validBackends empty).
The details always show the note "Campaign system is outdated.": the system is marked as legacy (isLegacy).
Probable bug: order = -tonumber(campaign.date) or 0 evaluates as (-tonumber(date)) or 0, so the "or 0" does not protect against a nil date (arithmetic error on nil).

onGameplaySelectorGetTiles.desc: Hook called when the selector collects its tiles. For the gameplaySelector backend, adds one tile per campaign (translated name, preview, level, beamNG or bug icons, key campaign_<sourceFile>). In all cases adds a "More Campaigns..." tile.

items.desc: List of tiles to complete (modified in place).

backend.desc: Calling backend; backendName must be "gameplaySelector" for the campaign tiles.

onGameplaySelectorGetDetails.desc: Hook called when the user opens a tile's details. If itemDetails.campaignSourceFile exists, loads the campaign and adds to details a block with title, description, preview, favorite, specifications (difficulty, authors, date, players, number of scenarios), labels (official, auxiliary, mod) and a "Start Campaign" button. This button records the item as recent, navigates to "play" and launches campaign_campaignsLoader.start.

details.desc: List of details blocks to complete.

buttonInstance.desc: Object providing addButton to create the buttons.
